detailed_descriptions.en: Spanning an incredible 54 tracks with a total runtime of 3 hours and 44 minutes, this comprehensive collection captures every shade of the city's shifting atmosphere. From the frantic energy of managing a Ramen bar to the serene solace of a rooftop apartment, this soundtrack seamlessly bridges the gap between a dystopian corporate future and cozy urban intimacy. Every track has been fully mastered for standalone listening and is delivered to your library in both high-quality MP3 and premium, lossless FLAC formats. Key Features: The Full Metropolis Anthology: Features 54 fully realized tracks encompassing over 3 and a half hours of continuous atmospheric music. Dual Format Audiophile Experience: Downloadable in both standard compressed MP3 and high-fidelity, lossless FLAC audio files. A Diverse Sonic Palette: Transitions smoothly between lo-fi chill-hop, nightclub synth-wave, ambient, and melancholic corporate soundscapes. Steam Music Integration: Fully compatible with the built-in Steam Media Player, as well as external media players for on-the-go listening.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Spanning an incredible 54 tracks with a total runtime of 3 hours and 44 minutes, this comprehensive collection captures every shade of the city's shifting atmosphere. From the frantic energy of managing a Ramen bar to the serene solace of a rooftop apartment, this soundtrack seamlessly bridges the gap between a dystopian corporate future and cozy urban intimacy.

Every track has been fully mastered for standalone listening and is delivered to your library in both high-quality MP3 and premium, lossless FLAC formats.

Key Features:


The Full Metropolis Anthology: Features 54 fully realized tracks encompassing over 3 and a half hours of continuous atmospheric music.

Dual Format Audiophile Experience: Downloadable in both standard compressed MP3 and high-fidelity, lossless FLAC audio files.

A Diverse Sonic Palette: Transitions smoothly between lo-fi chill-hop, nightclub synth-wave, ambient, and melancholic corporate soundscapes.

Steam Music Integration: Fully compatible with the built-in Steam Media Player, as well as external media players for on-the-go listening.
